newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PhyCor, MedCath started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PhyCor, MedCath started.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it initiated coverage of PhyCor Inc and MedCath Inc with buy ratings.
-- said expects PhyCor to post 35 percent earnings growth for the next three to five years.
-- set a 1997 earnings estimate for PhyCor at $0.83 a share.
-- set a 12-month price target of $40 a share.
-- said MedCath has an excellant management team in place and a "defined strategy for success."
-- said expects MedCath's revenues to increase almost 60 percent during fiscal 1997 to $104.3 million.
-- MedCath should post earnings growth in excess of 20 percent for the "foreseeable future."
-- set a 12-month price target of $20 a share.
